query: مقدار آخرین سند انبار مربوط به خرید کالای پنی سیلین 400 چقدر هست؟
sql:
SELECT TOP(1) quantity
FROM   inv_voucher_detail
       JOIN inv_voucher
         ON inv_voucher_detail. inventory_voucher_id = inv_voucher.id
       JOIN voucher_specification
         ON voucher_specification.id = inv_voucher. voucher_specification_id
       JOIN part
         ON voucher_detail.part_id = part.id
WHERE  voucher_specification.voucher_type = 'خرید'
       AND part.title LIKE '%پنی سیلین 400%'
       AND inv_voucher.state = 'ثبت شده'
AND voucher_specification.direction = 'ورودی'
ORDER  BY inv_voucher.date DESC

query: کل مصرف پنی سیلین 400 از اول بهار چقدر بوده؟
sql:
SELECT Sum(major_quantity)
FROM   inv_voucher_detail
       JOIN inv_voucher
         ON inv_voucher_detail.inventory_voucher_id = inv_voucher.id
       JOIN part
         ON part.id = inv_voucher_detail.partid
       JOIN voucher_specification
         ON voucher_specification.id = inv_voucher.voucher_specification_id
WHERE  part.title LIKE '%پنی سیلین 400%'
       AND voucher_specification.voucher_type LIKE '%مصرف%'
       AND voucher_specification.direction = 'خروجی'
       AND inv_voucher.date BETWEEN '2024-03-21' AND Getdate()
       AND inv_voucher.state IN ( 'تایید شده', 'ثبت شده' )
